adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController`, `before_filter :ensure_embeddable` runs before `best`. `ensure_embeddable` raises `Discourse::InvalidAccess` when `SiteSetting.embeddable_host.blank?` (default), so the spec `it "is 404 without an embed_url" do; get :best; response.should_not be_success; end` never exercises `params.require(:embed_url)` in `best` (which would raise on missing `embed_url`). Because the assertion is only `should_not be_success`, the test can pass while not actually validating the missing-`embed_url` behavior or status code implied by the test name.
